name_zh: 诺贝尔/挪威/炸药/和平奖：发明家慈善与和平遗产
name_en: Nobel/Norway/Dynamite/Peace Prize: Inventor Philanthropy & Peace Legacy
description_zh: 阿尔弗雷德·诺贝尔 (1833-1896) 瑞典/挪威发明家/炸药/雷管/355项专利/军工/和平/遗嘱/1895/诺贝尔奖/物理/化学/医学/文学/和平/经济/奥斯陆/斯德哥尔摩/遗产/挪威/瑞典/诺贝尔。核心模式：发明家慈善和平 — 炸药/专利/军工/财富/遗嘱/诺贝尔奖/和平/科学/文学/遗产/诺贝尔/挪威。体现 M254 发明家/慈善/和平 — 以"发明+财富+遗嘱+和平"四位一体，在军工财富/道德焦虑/无后代/世界和平四重张力中构建诺贝尔发明家慈善和平范式。
description_en: Alfred Nobel (1833-1896) Swedish/Norwegian inventor/dynamite/detonator/355 patents/arms/peace/will/1895/Nobel Prize/physics/chemistry/medicine/literature/peace/economics/Oslo/Stockholm/legacy/Norway/Sweden/Nobel. Core model: Inventor Philanthropy Peace — dynamite/patents/arms/wealth/will/Nobel Prize/peace/science/literature/legacy/Nobel/Norway. Exemplifies M254 Inventor/Philanthropy/Peace — quaternity of 'invention + wealth + will + peace' building Nobel inventor philanthropy peace paradigm amid quadruple tensions of arms wealth/moral anxiety/childless/world peace.
reason_zh: 诺贝尔非单纯发明家，而是"发明+财富+遗嘱+和平"四位一体道德转身者。以炸药发家，以遗嘱赎罪，以诺贝尔奖重塑人类最高荣誉。M254 区隔于 M237 解放联邦(玻利瓦尔)、M242 贫民实验(穆希卡)、M226 资源治理(卡马)，核心在于"发明即财富基础+财富即道德负担+遗嘱即赎罪机制+和平即永恒遗产"的诺贝尔发明家慈善和平范式。
reason_en: Nobel not mere inventor but 'invention + wealth + will + peace' quaternity moral transformer. Made fortune from dynamite, atoned through will, reshaped humanity's highest honors through Nobel Prize. M254 distinct from M237 Liberation Federation (Bolivar), M242 Peasant Experiment (Mujica), M226 Resource Governance (Khama), core: 'invention as wealth base + wealth as moral burden + will as atonement mechanism + peace as eternal legacy' Nobel inventor philanthropy peace paradigm.
